desc: Normalize the conceptual constraints as `(min(a,b), max(a,b))` and derive the prefix-sweep formulation.
Derive that the baseline contribution for right endpoint `x` is `x - max_left_seen`.
Implement the sweep with duplicate-left multiplicity and unique-owner tracking, producing per-pair removal gains.
Prove correctness of the gain calculation, including duplicate identical pairs and ties on normalized left endpoints.
Validate the implementation against both examples and brute-force random small cases.
